text: why though. why is it suddenly a massive host flush? what happens on the workspace/character route that doesnt happen on the old /character route ?
resolution: Explained the WORKFREEZE host-flush cause with measured data and source comparison: /workbench mounts the character stage through the workbench character source with fresh workbench-scoped state/paintable ids, while /characters uses the old route state/chr-* namespace. The old and workbench stages share PartMeshes, but /workbench first visit replays dynamic Globe mesh CREATE payloads under fresh dynamic geometry keys, so the host receives a huge reconciler drain (measured 142,460,237 bytes in 788,280us; total mount 712,304,674 bytes over 18 batches) even though store/panel/render timings are 0ms. No source change or commit was made for this explanatory ask.
